about.title: About me
about.text1: I am a web developer passionate about creating modern, functional, and visually appealing digital experiences.
about.text2: I enjoy combining development and design to build clean, dynamic interfaces tailored to each user's needs. Creativity is an essential part of my work, as I am always looking for new ways to solve problems and deliver value through innovative digital solutions.
about.text3: I enjoy exploring new technologies, refining my skills, and taking on new challenges that allow me to continue growing as a developer. My goal is to create web products that not only work well but also convey a strong and memorable visual identity.
